claims.assertion: Swaruu says Venus's visible 3D image is filtered; in 5D it is a temperate tropical ocean world, averaging 30°C, with abundant life and better oxygen than Earth.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: She describes Venusians as humanlike, spiritually advanced but technologically less developed; their general population reportedly does not know Earth.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: Anéeka says over 80% of species, plants, and animals match between Venus and Earth.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
